title: Equity and hybrid scheme categories
objectives: Match equity category names to their rules.
Describe hybrid categories by equity share.
body_md:
## Equity categories (examples)

| Category | Key rule |
|---|---|
| **Large cap** | At least 80% in the top 100 companies by market cap |
| **Mid cap** | At least 65% in companies ranked 101 to 250 |
| **Small cap** | At least 65% in companies ranked 251 and below |
| **Large and mid cap** | At least 35% each in large and mid caps |
| **Multi cap** | At least 25% each in large, mid and small caps; 75% in equity |
| **Flexi cap** | At least 65% in equity, no cap-size rules |
| **Focused** | Maximum 30 stocks |
| **ELSS** | 3-year lock-in; tax deduction under the old regime (Section 80C) |
| **Sectoral / thematic** | At least 80% in the chosen sector or theme |

## Hybrid categories

| Category | Equity share |
|---|---|
| Conservative hybrid | 10% to 25% equity, 75% to 90% debt |
| Balanced hybrid | 40% to 60% equity |
| Aggressive hybrid | 65% to 80% equity |
| Equity savings | Equity, debt and arbitrage |
| Arbitrage | At least 65% in equity, hedged |
| Multi asset | At least three asset classes, each at least 10% |

> **Exam tip:** Learn the numbers 80, 65, 25, 30. They appear often.
example: A focused fund can hold at most 30 stocks. A multi cap fund must hold at least 25% each in large, mid and small caps.
say: Check the category: a small-cap fund is more volatile than a large-cap fund.
ELSS has a three-year lock-in, shorter than most tax-saving options.
never: All equity funds carry the same risk.
ELSS can be redeemed in a year.

check.q: A large-cap fund must invest at least what share in large caps?
check.why: At least 80% of assets go to the top 100 companies.

check.q: A focused fund may hold at most:
check.why: SEBI caps focused funds at 30 stocks.

check.q: The lock-in period of an ELSS is:
check.why: ELSS units are locked in for three years.
